name: Dahaka
_notes: Transcribed from sheet DU2514 (Lv I-IX), combined AI/BP cards DR2514-DR2533 (AI on top, BP on bottom of the same card), status card DZ2584 (Fearful Hospitality / Outstaying Your Welcome).

Each deck card carries both parts: AI fields (name, aiTier, kind, steps...) and BP fields (bpName, tier = BP level, atLo = gold Interrupt AT, at = regular AT, responses incl. INTERRUPT ones). Deck building and escalation use the BP level only (Storybook p.11).
Level strip icons: lotus = ESCALATION, eye-shield = AT, diamond = EVADE_DICE, A = DANGER (per hit from Lv V). Lv I lotus +1.

traits: Land That Knows Nothing of the Sea

traits.Shackles of Regret: See Additional Setup. Apply the following modifiers to all Dahaka Attacks: -1 EVADE_DICE and -1 DANGER per hit (minimum 1). As long as this Trait is active, the End of Hope Trait is disabled.
traits.Drifter of Wastes: The Dahaka ignores Line of Sight. Drift: When the Dahaka performs Drift, it moves through the Target stopping directly across the Target, then turns to face them. If the Dahaka cannot Drift across the Target, it stops adjacent to the Target and the Target dies. If the Dahaka moves through a Titan during Drift, that Titan gains a negative Precision token. Drift does not cause Crash. Dissipate: Move the Dahaka to the closest Ambrosia Cloud Terrain tile other than the one it is currently on, so that its base is fully placed on the Terrain tile, then turn it to face the most Titans. Triggers when prompted.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Soulrend: Soulrend: Lose 1 Mnemos node from every Mnemos. Triggers when prompted.
traits.Semicorporeal Wraith: When the special ◆! comes up, a Titan adjacent to the Dahaka may perform an Interrupt Attack. If they do, they gain a combat Fatigue token. Bonus Attacks are always Interrupt Attacks (but you do not gain the combat Fatigue token). Chain Break doesn't disable the special ◆!.
traits.Shadowstep X: The Dahaka moves X spaces directly away from the Target, without turning. If it would move past the Board Edge, it appears on the other side of the Board in a straight line from its previous position and continues the movement in the same direction.
traits.Winnowing: Remove the Fearful Hospitality card and add the Trojan Ire and The Oar cards to the Battle (See Cycle IV Storybook, p. 171).
traits.Land That Knows Nothing of the Sea: When you gain The Oar card, immediately flip it.
traits.Forbidden Alchemy: When you gain Ambrosia tokens in any way, double the amount gained.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Bane of Odysseus: If you don't pass the Trojan Ire card, die. Then, random Titan gains the Trojan Ire.
traits.Contaminated Cuts: End of Titan turn: Gain DANGER equal to the number of Ambrosia tokens you have.
traits.Shadow Backstep: When the Dahaka Shadowsteps through the Board Edge, Heal 1.
traits.The Dragon Does Not Sleep: Additional Setup: Place a Combo token on the Cleaver space of the Combo track. After resolving a Combo or Combo Break, move the token clockwise to the next space. Combo: Dahaka AI cards cannot be Interrupt Attacked, unless you perform a Combo Break. Combo Break: A Titan who is not the Priority Target and has a Weapon with a Weapon class indicated by the Combo track may exhaust this Weapon to break the Combo. The Titan must be within this Weapon's effective range. They gain the Priority Target token. Note: RAGE gain doesn't trigger Priority Target change. CLEAVER: Slabsword, Knife, Shield, Whip. SMOKE: Spear, Sword, Kusarigama. AMBROSIA: Pistols, Club, Axe, Harpoon.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Incorporeal Wraith: The Dahaka can only be Wounded by Interrupt Attacks. Always use the higher AT value of the BP cards.

Fearful Hospitality.text: Start of Battle: Random Titan gains this card. The Titan gains the Precise keyword. Pass Fearful Hospitality: Can be passed to an adjacent Titan as a free action. When you pass Fearful Hospitality, gain a permanent positive Precision token. You cannot pass Fearful Hospitality to a Titan with a positive Precision token. If, at the end of your turn, there is no eligible Titan to pass Fearful Hospitality, discard this card and every positive Precision token in the game. If a Titan with the Fearful Hospitality dies, pass the Fearful Hospitality to the closest Titan. End of Titan turn: If you have this at the end of your turn, flip it.

Outstaying Your Welcome.text: End of Titan turn: If you have this at the end of your turn, discard this card and every positive Precision token in the game. Pass Outstaying Your Welcome: Can be passed to an adjacent Titan as a free action. When you pass Outstaying Your Welcome, flip it. You cannot pass Outstaying Your Welcome to a Titan with a positive Precision token. If, at the end of your turn, there is no eligible Titan to pass Outstaying Your Welcome, discard this card and every positive Precision token in the game. If a Titan with the Outstaying Your Welcome dies, pass the Outstaying Your Welcome to the closest Titan.

Trojan Ire.text: Start of Battle: Random Titan gains this card. You can be Targeted only if there are no other viable Targets. You cannot perform Attacks. Pass the Ire: Can be passed to an adjacent Titan as a free action. When you pass the Trojan Ire, gain the Oar Condition card. If, at the end of your turn, there is no eligible Titan to pass the Trojan Ire, every Titan dies. If a Titan with the Trojan Ire dies, pass the Trojan Ire to the closest Titan. End of Titan turn: If you have this at the end of your turn, flip it.

Lotus Eaters Curse.text: Start of Titan turn: If you have this at the start of your turn, permanently lose 1 Mnemos card and all associated nodes. This card does not return to the Mnemos Vault. If you can't lose a Mnemos card, you are erased from existence. Pass the Curse: Can be passed to an adjacent Titan as a free action. When you pass the Lotus Eaters Curse, flip it. You gain the Winnowed Condition card. If, at the end of your turn, there is no eligible Titan to pass the Lotus Eaters Curse, every Titan dies. If a Titan with the Lotus Eaters Curse dies, pass the Lotus Eaters Curse to the closest Titan.

The Oar.text: When you gain this card, and there are no BP cards in the discard pile, you may discard the top BP card. You gain the Precise keyword. You cannot gain the Trojan Ire or Lotus Eaters Curse cards.

Winnowed.text: You cannot use Mnemos card abilities during this Battle. You cannot gain the Trojan Ire or Lotus Eaters Curse cards.
